name: House AI
tagline: Redesign any room from a photo
description: AI interior and exterior design. Share a photo of a room, a house or a yard, pick one of 100+ styles, and get a photorealistic redesign of that same space. Also preview wall paint and flooring, empty or virtually stage a room, and find real furniture and decor to match. Sign in with a House AI account; designs use House AI credits.
